findings.summary: Accepted with high confidence. The summands telescope exactly by defining D_i=I(A;B|Y^i,Z_{i+1}^n), giving I(A;B|Y^n)-I(A;B|Z^n). Fano bounds the normalized absolute defect by max{δ₁,δ₂}, which vanishes for reliable bounded-rate code sequences. This remains a sequence-level condition and does not itself yield a compact fixed-alphabet single-letter outer region.

Accepted with high confidence. Memorylessness and deterministic encoding establish the selected-coordinate factorization with the stronger fixed-map property X=f_T(U,V), independent of W. Fano, chain rules, and the conditioned Csiszár identity justify both individual-rate rows and both sum-rate rows, with only nonnegative remainders discarded. No simultaneous cardinality or compactness reduction is proved, so arbitrary small-alphabet optimization would not certify a universal converse.

Accepted with high confidence. The derivative analysis proves the global affine support g(q)≤2r(1−q), with exact tangent contact at q=1/5. Averaging over fair-input posterior probabilities gives I(X;Z|A)−I(X;Y|A)≤r, and the stated posterior mixture attains equality, making the constant sharp in this scalar direction; the reflected inequality follows likewise.

Accepted with high confidence. The independent-component construction is an actual finite joint distribution satisfying the stated structural, entropy, BEC-subtuple, and support constraints. Exact component accounting gives B₁=B₂=2h₂(1/4)−5/4, with both support rows tight. The exact formal-entropy checker credibly corroborates the component bookkeeping, including the 65 disjoint-subtuple identities.

The actual finite counterfeit satisfies every universally valid finite-variable information inequality, including non-Shannon inequalities. Standard copy-lemma extensions can be realized by the required conditional resampling, so no finite sequence of such extensions can exclude the witness or force the specified coarse relaxation below 2h₂(1/4)−5/4. The obstruction is limited to this relaxation and these universal-inequality/copy-lemma strengthening methods.

The value 2h₂(1/4)−5/4=0.3725562489182657… is only the objective value of a deliberately over-relaxed entropy formulation. It is neither a lower nor an upper bound on the actual BSSC capacity, does not determine the BSSC sum-capacity or improve its numerical frontier, and therefore does not contradict the smaller fixed-pair capacity upper bound in the supplied evidence.
